description: Fetch the 54-week historical Google Trends Interest Over Time curve (0–100 normalized weekly points), YoY velocity %, peak week, and multi-keyword comparison (up to 5 comma-separated keywords). Cost: 10 Credits / call ($0.83–$1.25/1K; 0 Credits on 4xx/5xx error).

keyword.description: One keyword or up to 5 comma-separated keywords to compare, e.g. "mcp server" or "claude,chatgpt".

name: google_trends_interest

keyword.description: Queried keyword or comma-separated comparison list.

peak_interest.description: Peak normalized interest score across the window (0–100).

weeks_count.description: Number of weekly data points returned.

meta.description: Response telemetry metadata including request_id, credit cost, cache hit flag, and latency.

cached.description: True when served from warm Redis/PostgreSQL cache.

count.description: Number of primary result items returned.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on 4xx/5xx error).

request_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this API request.

title: Google Trends 54-Week Historical Interest Curve (0–100)
